'''Erkens''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] of the [[Tarlam]] [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Makeb]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] in [[3638 BBY]] she was rescued from an [[Isotope-5 droid]] by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agent, after which her councilor [[Soler]] asked their rescuer to cover the Tarlam shuttle pads with energy shields to prevent the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] from landing reinforcements. After being left in the [[City Hall]], Erkens was taken hostage by the officer [[Balog (Chiss)|Balog]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Balog demanded the Republic agent to allow him and his men to leave with the sample of [[Isotope-5]] in exchange for sparing the Mayor's life; his demands were eventually met. Erkens thanked her rescuer for the second time and proceeded to evacuate the planet on [[the Ark]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mayor Erkens appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion, released on [[April 9]], [[2013]]. If the player chooses a Dark Side option, Balog shoots Erkens in the head instead of letting her live.
